title: Service quality and fairness
question: Does a download-only view miss problems, and can remoteness classes be compared?
answer: Download-only misses most of it: 259 of 437 flagged records (59%) worsened only in upload or latency. Outside major cities too few records qualify to rank remoteness classes.
method: Two-quarter deterioration of 20%+ in download, upload or latency, on one common set of eligible records; official ABS 2021 remoteness areas.
